title_original: Netflix Unveils Penélope Cruz & Juan Diego Botto’s Domestic Violence Drama ‘Patricia’ As Production Gets Underway

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE : Netflix has announced the start of production on Juan Diego Botto ‘s domestic violence drama Patricia starring Penélope Cruz, who also produces under the banner of her audiovisual company Moonlyon .
The news comes as Cruz enjoys a buzzy awards season thank to her roles in Best International Feature Film Oscar frontrunner La Bola Negra and Bunker .

blocks.text: It is the second feature film for Argentinian-Spanish actor and director Botto, who previously worked with Cruz on his directorial debut, the 2022 social thriller On The Fringe .

blocks.text: Patricia marks the first narrative feature for Cruz’s Moonlyon, which has been developing a number of projects since its launch in 2022 as part of the Barcelona-based sports and entertainment group Imagina, which was rebranded from Grup Mediapro in September .
Cruz will play the titular Patricia, a woman who escapes the hell of a twelve-year abusive relationship only to face another hell in the courts, where she fears for the wellbeing of her children.
The cast also includes Goya Toledo ( Amores Perros, Marsella ), Ramón Barea ( Lullaby , Everybody knows ) and Dylan Radley among others.

Cruz, whose career has also been defined by her longtime collaboration with Pedro Almodóvar on films such as Volver and Pain and Glory, revealed she was psyched to be getting Patricia into production.
“After more than two years developing what will be the first narrative feature from my production company, Moonlyon, and just about to start shooting, I feel enormous excitement,” she said.

“It has been a beautiful and intense journey alongside my dear Juan Diego Botto. Juan has written a wonderful script, and it is an honor to tell this story with him. It is a very necessary story, and an immense privilege to play this character. Patricia represents so many other women who, like her, suffer this kind of violence every day,” she continued.

“I am also very grateful for the incredible response from Netflix in Spain since they read the script. This is my first film with them, and we couldn’t be happier with the care and attention they have shown us.”

Argentinian Spanish actor and director Botto is a celebrated actor with close to 80 features to his name, with recent credits including The Suicide Squad , The Room Next Door and Breaking Falls . His feature directorial debut On The Fringe premiered in the Venice Film Festival’s Horizons sidebar in 2022.

“After two years of writing and a long research process, which included hours of interviews with women who trusted us with their stories, it is a privilege for me to tell this story with this cast and this creative team,” he said.

Netflix launched in Spain in 2015, where it has since established its biggest European production hub dedicated to non-English-language production. To mark the 10th anniversary of its arrival in the country, it pledged more than €1B ($1.1B) in investment into Spanish production between 2025 and 2028.

“Some stories matter to us for what they tell and how they are told, and Patricia is one of those rare and unforgettable stories: brave and courageous, brought to life by an extraordinary team,” said Diego Ávalos, Netflix’s vice president originals for Spain, Portugal, Turkey and Middle East.
“I’m truly honored to join Juan Diego Botto and Penélope Cruz in their first film for Netflix in Spain, and for a story born at home to move audiences here and around the world.”
